subject: science
title: Unit 2: Volume and Pitch of Sound
subTitle: Lesson 2.2, Decibel Measurements & Animal Hearing

cards.vietnamese: Biên độ rung lớn hơn -> Tạo âm lượng to hơn (Louder sound)
cards.definition: Bigger vibrations produce louder sounds; smaller vibrations produce quieter sounds.
cards.example: Hitting a drum harder creates larger vibrations and higher decibels.

exercises.question: What happens when you hit a drum with much greater force?
options: Vibrations get smaller and sound is quieter
Vibrations get bigger and sound is louder
The drum pitch changes to very low
exercises.explanation: Tác dụng lực mạnh hơn tạo ra dao động lớn hơn, do đó âm lượng phát ra to hơn (louder sound).
